subject: Affordable Housing Trust Organization and Training
overview: The board elected its first slate of officers, established working groups for trust documentation, and received a comprehensive training presentation from the Massachusetts Housing Partnership. Members also reviewed a $250,000 Community Preservation Act application to fund upcoming housing initiatives.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the August 7, 2024 meeting with amendments regarding historical CPC funding and office titles.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust Training
items.summary: Shelly Goren of the Massachusetts Housing Partnership presented a training on trust statutes, funding mechanisms, and the importance of creating measurable goals based on housing production plans. The board discussed the limitations of using Community Preservation Act funds for nexus studies and the specific verbs governing allowable uses.

items.title: Election of Officers
items.summary: Elected Lisa Ann Davidson as Chair, Penelope Taylor as Vice Chair, and Carrie Weaver as Treasurer.

items.title: Establishment of Working Groups
items.summary: Established working groups to draft the Declaration of Trust and a Trust Action Plan, with members assigned to coordinate before the next meeting.

items.title: CPA Funding Application
items.summary: Reviewed a $250,000 Community Preservation Act application covering technical assistance for city-owned lots, construction support, and housing assistance programs. The board revised the proposal to frame projects as examples pending the completion of a formal trust action plan.
